title: PDF logo: the uploaded logo, else the bundled ShopView logo; CSV never
refs: SV-8654 (TU spec v5 2026-07-29 S7-R11; S7-N2; S7-N3 — logo now resolved by the shared resolver: the organization's uploaded logo,else the bundled ShopView default)
custom_preconds: 1. You can toggle the shop's logo in the shop settings (restore the original state afterwards - shared env).
custom_steps:
1. With a shop logo set, download the Summary PDF and the Expanded PDF and look at the top of each.
2. Download the CSV and inspect it.
3. Remove the shop logo and download both PDFs again.
custom_expected:
1. With an uploaded logo, BOTH PDF views show that logo at the top of the report.
2. The CSV never includes the logo.
3. With NO uploaded logo, the PDF views show the bundled ShopView logo instead — not a blank space and not an error.
